people.name: Capernaum

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
translations.bsb: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
translations.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
translations.asv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received the half-shekel came to Peter, and said, Doth not your teacher pay the half-shekel?
